entries.title: A Batches panel shows your batched changes while Batched pull requests is on
entries.body: With the Batched pull requests runbook on, a Batches panel on the right shows the open batch and its checks, the changes waiting and any left out, and the batches that ended in the last day. Press a change to open its task, or Answer in Settings when a batch is held. Show your batches in command search puts up every detail on one card.

picture.alt: The Batches panel on the right rail showing a batch held on a failed check, its two changes, one change waiting, one left out and a closed Last day
